summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation regarding a regular distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-1. The filing reports an interest distribution of $186,250 for the period ending April 15, 2026, with details on per-certificate interest income for Form 1099 reporting. No transaction, strategic review, management change, or other special situation event is described. The filing is a standard periodic reporting obligation for an asset-backed security trust, notifying certificateholders of the scheduled interest payment.
